title: Repair a bug from the CLI

chapters.title: Repair an invoice bug without changing the tests
chapters.caption: The deliverable is changed source code. The same original tests must fail before the repair and pass afterward.

chapters.title: Your terminal controls a remote workspace
chapters.caption: There is no Kubernetes exec, host repository mount, or paid provider key in this recording.

chapters.title: Install the CLI and choose the runtime
chapters.caption: The opencode template is ready. Installation is local; OpenCode is already installed in the remote template.

chapters.title: Create and retain the sandbox ID
chapters.caption: Retain the sandbox ID and confirm running before continuing. TTL is a fallback, not the cleanup step.

chapters.title: Upload the broken source and original tests
chapters.caption: Only source and tests are uploaded. No completed fix is supplied to the agent.

chapters.title: Configure the main and auxiliary free models
chapters.caption: Both models are explicit. No paid fallback. Free-provider data policies still apply to the uploaded task.

chapters.title: Establish the failure before asking for a fix
chapters.caption: Recorded baseline: four tests, one pass, three failures. The test SHA-256 must remain unchanged after the repair.

chapters.title: Give OpenCode the complete repair contract
chapters.caption: Discount subtotal, round cents, add shipping unchanged. The agent must edit and test, not merely propose a fix.

chapters.title: Start the agent as a tracked command
chapters.caption: Retain the command ID. The 240-second limit bounds execution; the next command waits for its result.

chapters.title: Wait and inspect real tool activity
chapters.caption: Completed tools and zero-cost model steps must exist. A successful process alone does not establish a correct repair.

chapters.title: Review the actual agent work
chapters.caption: Real read, edit and bash calls completed. The model did not receive a prewritten replacement implementation.

chapters.title: Rerun the unchanged acceptance tests
chapters.caption: Four tests pass, zero fail, and the original test hash matches. Review the diff before adopting the code.

chapters.title: The repair passes the original contract
chapters.caption: Independent test run: 4 passed, 0 failed. Test file unchanged. Completed model steps reported zero cost.

chapters.title: Retrieve useful work, then terminate
chapters.caption: The recorded sandbox is terminated. Provider failure, timeout or a bad repair still requires cleanup.

editing: Real CLI output replay; condensed SDK excerpts; real UI recordings. Waiting removed. No speed benchmark or voiceover.
